overview_description.description: SMC is a health care center, Over 600 inpatient beds and 250 outpatient clinics are served by a devoted and highly qualified multinational team of over 500 full-time physicians and 2,500 paramedical and support workers at SMC. They have continually been effective in making all types of treatments available to patients with the highest standards of comprehensive health care over the years. They've laid a solid basis to ensure that they stay at the forefront of the region's healthcare industry. In the Kingdom, SMC is a recognized academic and training resource. SMC provides a wide range of primary health care services and medical checks, as well as support services and programs to help people live healthier lives, such as executive check-up programs and permitted tests for marriage, driver's license, employment, and weapon possession permits.

product.name: Emergency Department
product.description: Provides 24/7 emergency medical care for critical and urgent cases including accidents and severe health conditions.

product.description: Offers medical consultations and treatments across over 250 clinics covering common and specialized medical fields from 9 AM to 9 PM.

product.name: Surgical Services
product.description: Performs minor to major surgical procedures in outpatient settings, including advanced and precise operations.

product.name: Intensive Care Units (ICU)
product.description: Provides specialized intensive care with advanced monitoring for critically ill adult patients, including cardiac intensive care.

product.name: Dental Services
product.description: Offers comprehensive dental care through 25 fully equipped clinics covering all dental specialties with laser technology.
